newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell says exchange ratio set for deal.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell says exchange ratio set for deal.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp said Friday it has set the stock exchange ratio for the sale of its aerospace and defense businesses to Boeing Co at 0.042 Boeing share for each Rockwell share held by Rockwell shareholders.
The deal, announced in early August, is expected to go before shareholders in early December. The transaction has been valued at about $3.2 billion.
Under the pact, Boeing is to issue about $860 million of common stock, take over about $2.165 billion of Rockwell debt, and assume certain pension obligations of Rockwell.

The exchange ratio was based on the average dailly closing price of Boeing common stock during the 20-trading-day period ended November 27, and the number of Rockwell shares issued and outstanding as of November 25.
Rockwell said a total of about 9.19 million shares of Boeing will be issued in the transaction.
Rockwell's aerospace and defense businesses are to become a subsidiary of Boeing.
